[quote=united_hydronia;59104663]First I would like to negotiate a trade deal between our countries, then we can discuss more from there if you wish, said the president. Minister Erdemir then said We would be willing to sell our oil, aluminium or lithium, what could you give in return?[/quote]

[i]"The empire has endless deposits of gold. So much gold we build countless golden dragon statues in every major city, at least a pair of statues located at every entrance to a city. We can supply you with this gold, and our luxury industry is vast. Jewellery, watches, clothing, and every other luxury item under the stars and night we produce in the empire. So in exchange for the metals, we will export our gold and luxury. Additionally, we are rich in copper and make tonnes of bronze. I know for a fact that copper wiring is quite a necessary thing in this day and age, we can sell you that too."[/i]

Kura paused for a moment and looked down at the paper again. [i]"Though, we make a lot of oil, I don't know how much the Empress or Master of Coin will allow, but we will buy some of your oil to progress our industry. Likely though we will have to place some restrictions on the oil, we don't want too much being under-utilised..."[/i]

Kura looked back up and pressed her hands together, facing the president directly. [i]"So. Other than gold and luxury items, or bronze and copper, what else does Hydronia seek. Perhaps our agriculture, much of the population is in the cities and leaving for vast farms of dragons or common animals, perhaps you want to buy dragon meat or scales. Or maybe you are more interested in our rising shipping industry."[/i]
